prompts.light: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a finished wallpaper image for a developer's zTerm terminal background, LIGHT edition of a matching light/dark pair. Create one full-bleed wide 16:9 landscape image, ideally 2560x1440. Minimal atmospheric abstract mountain landscape, three broad flowing ridgelines along the bottom quarter and lower side edges, soft mist and satin smooth gradients. Most of the upper and central 75 percent must be extremely quiet open negative space, with a nearly uniform luminous warm ivory background. Refined contemporary Japanese-inspired ambient landscape, painterly digital matte, understated and elegant. Palette: warm ivory #f2eee5, pale stone #e8e6de, very desaturated sage grey #d5ddd7, distant muted blue-grey #d8e0e4. All edges gentle and diffused; low contrast across the entire scene, optimized as background for black terminal text and syntax colors. Very subtle depth, no fine grain or fine details. No sun, no moon, no stars, no buildings, no people, no symbols, no feather, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no text, no code, no screen, no UI, no frame. This is the wallpaper itself, NOT a screenshot or a mockup, NOT a collage, only ONE light wallpaper.
